independenceMethod: Reopened adopted EER structure/outcomes and enriched-course content, independently transcribed credit sequences and recalculated schedules, read every completed alignment and visible explanation, then compared with frozen final canonical/decision records. Separate verification pass, not a second person. Earlier approval and correction narratives were not used as academic authority.

results.sourceFirstAcademicConclusion: Retain qualified positive comparison. Independent reading of the source outcomes identifies international public governance as the organising inquiry. UCR politics, international/EU law, sociology, public economics, organisations and empirical methods jointly support that inquiry. Climate governance is explicitly supported by exact-target programme questions; its technical courses contribute complementary scientific/energy/resource analysis. Dedicated migration/development, public-policy sequence and compulsory thesis remain visible limitations, not claimed equivalents. The seven-course/52.5-EC difference follows the climate concept. No additional route established merely by switching related contextual courses.

results.sourceFirstAcademicConclusion: Approve academic no-match, not a blocked research attempt. Source outcomes require a connected pedagogical/educational inquiry including upbringing, contextual intervention and subject-specific research. Grant actual child/adolescent clinical assessment, lifespan development, didactic exercise design with primary-school pupils, educator-facing youth resilience and language acquisition/dyslexia. These establish stronger partial relevance than the old cache-only challenge claimed. They still do not connect the broader 24-course clinical/neuroscience/social composition into sustained parenting support or educational-systems inquiry. General public policy, ethics, history, rhetoric and methods additions do not supply that missing organising content. Both target-supported Pedagogiek and Onderwijswetenschappen directions were considered; no quota, title or licence requirement was imposed.
